items: Legends can show their age and their standing now: a grey muzzle and brows, an ear bitten in some old fight, a tusk or horn broken short, a bronze torc, rings on horns and tusks, earrings, cuffs on their legs, a garland, little bells. The old wolf wears a torc and a torn ear; the boar has a broken tusk and bronze bands on the other; the ram's horns are ringed, a bell at each tip; the shrine fox has rings in its ears and a bell at its throat
